d.seg: చేస్తాను అందరూ వాట్సాప్ వాట్సాప్లో వీడియో కాల్ చేస్తాను
d.tr: I will do it, everyone does WhatsApp video calls.
d.ctx: The user proposes moving to WhatsApp for a video call. The other person responds by saying it is not their type.
d.j: Proposing to move to an external app for a call.

d.ctx: The user asks for 300 rupees. The other person responds by saying it is not their type.
d.j: Asking for money for a service.

d.seg: చిచ్చిబాబోయ్ ఇన్ని నా టైప్ కాదు బాబోయ్ ఇన్ని నా టైప్ కాదు ఊరికే టైం తీసుకొచ్చాను
d.tr: Oh no, this is not my type, I just brought it up to pass time.
d.ctx: The user asked for money and WhatsApp, the expert denies it.
d.j: Refusal of the previous request for money and external contact.

d.tr: It would be nice if you actually did it, do it.
d.ctx: The user is insisting on the previous request. The other person does not respond clearly.
d.j: Insisting on the previous request for external contact.
